title: Administration, i18n and documentation

subtasks.description: Define a role-specific information architecture and complete Persian/English message catalog, including errors and empty/degraded states.
Standardize locale-aware dates/numbers and Persian/Arabic text normalization without changing raw evidence.
Test RTL/LTR layout, focus order, keyboard controls, screen-reader labels and narrow-screen review workflows.
Build validated admin forms for providers, scorecards, retention, quotas and integration settings with secret masking.
Version changes, preview their impact, enforce permission checks and support rollback/audit.
Write product, API, architecture, install, SaaS/private admin, integration, security, backup, upgrade, troubleshooting and model/QA configuration guides.
Have a new operator and supervisor complete installation/admin/review tasks from documentation alone; correct observed gaps.

dependency_note: Documentation follows each package incrementally; complete admin acceptance depends on listed policy modules.
